correctness.rationale: For n>=3 crowns, only deleted-matching endpoints are at distance three. Any selected set with at least three vertices therefore automatically provides a distinct selected distance<=2 witness to each chosen vertex. The dominating sets are precisely all of A or B, selections with >=2 from each shore, and singleton shore selections whose matching mate is among >=2 vertices on opposite shore. Two-vertex dominating sets fail the witness condition. Thus S_n(z)=2z^n+((1+z)^n-1-nz)^2+2n z²((1+z)^(n-1)-1). Single-vertex deletion classifies minimal sets as exactly both shores, 2n(n-1) matched triples, and C(n,2)C(n-2,2) two-plus-two disjoint-index sets, giving minimal polynomial 2z^n+2n(n-1)z³+C(n,2)C(n-2,2)z⁴. Lower optimum 3 and upper minimal n. Independently verified all subsets and minimal status n3..6; universal claim analytic.
